about: Business email in a space: mail to addresses on a domain the business keeps with its own mail service arrives as a message in a space, carrying what a reply to it needs (reply_with); a reply written there carries that as `send`, and goes out from the address the mail came to. Each mail service is one row of providers; adding a service is a row here plus its service-connections recipe and event source, never code.

words.not_connected: Connect {provider} first: open {keys_at}, create a key with Full access, and paste it on Connections under {provider}.
words.no_domain: {provider} has no domain on this account yet. Add the business's domain there first.
words.receiving_off: {domain} sends through {provider} but does not receive there yet. Turn on receiving for it: {receiving_help}
words.not_on_domain: {address} is not on {domains}, the domains this {provider} account keeps.
words.connected: Mail to {addresses} now arrives in this space, and replies written here go out from {send_as}.
